AttachmentDetailDto.description: Full attachment details returned by the GET attachment endpoint.

AttachmentSummaryDto.description: Lightweight attachment metadata embedded in Message responses.

Citation.description: A citation extracted from provider annotations.

attachment_id.description: The attachment UUID (the provider file id before mapping).

CitationSource.description: Whether a citation came from a file or web search.

CreateChatReq.description: Request DTO for creating a new chat.

ImgThumbnailDto.description: Server-generated preview thumbnail for an image attachment.

MiniChatMessageDto.description:
Response DTO for a message in the list endpoint.

Aliased to `MiniChatMessageDto` in the `OpenAPI`` schema: `chat-engine` also
exposes a `MessageDto`, and both gears register into the same api-gateway
`OpenAPI`` registry, so the bare ident would collide in `components.schemas`.

oneOf.description: The caller's reaction to this message; `null` when there is none.

MiniChatSseEvent.description:
`OpenAPI` description of one SSE event of the `messages:stream`, retry and
edit responses. Each event is sent as `event: <name>` and `data: <payload>`
(JSON); `event` below is the SSE event name and `data` its payload. This
type only documents the wire format; `StreamEvent::into_sse_event` writes it.

ModelDto.description: Response DTO for a single model.

ModelListDto.description: Response DTO for the model list endpoint.

PingData.description:
Payload of the `ping` event: an empty JSON object (a unit struct would
be documented as `null`).

Problem.description: RFC 9457 problem+json. `context` varies by error category.

QuotaWarning.description: Per-tier, per-period quota warning entry in the SSE `done` event.

next_reset.description:
RFC 3339 timestamp of the next quota-period reset.
Present when `warning` or `exhausted` is true; absent otherwise.

SetReactionReq.description: Request DTO for setting a reaction.

request_id.description: Idempotency key: any UUID; generated by the server when omitted.

StreamStartedData.description:
Stream header event carrying the stream request ID and server-generated
assistant message ID.

Emitted as the first event in every SSE stream (both new generations and
replays). `is_new_turn` distinguishes replayed completed turns from live
generations.

is_new_turn.description:
`true` for a live generation (new turn); `false` when the stream
replays an already-completed turn (idempotent replay).

oneOf.description:
Present when a thread summary is included in the context window.
UI can display an informational indicator.

TextSpan.description: A character span within response text.

ThreadSummaryInfo.description:
Metadata about a thread summary applied to the current turn's context.

Sent in the `stream_started` event when the conversation has an active
thread summary. The UI can use this to show an informational banner.

token_estimate.description: Estimated token cost of the summary in the context window.

ToolPhase.description: Lifecycle phase of a tool invocation within a stream.

TurnStatusState.description: Turn state as reported by the turn status endpoint.

UpdateChatReq.description: Request DTO for updating a chat title.
